resource.description: Generates a full resource module from a resource-schema model

root.description: Generates the backend composition root (root module, bootstrap, environment templates)

kernel.description: Scaffolds the backend shared kernel (copy-once) the generated modules build upon

shared-domain.description: Generates the frontend/backend shared DTO lib from the model registry

frontend-kernel.description: Scaffolds the Angular shared kernel (copy-once) the emitted components import

strip-ai-slots.description: Delivery step: removes the @ai:begin/@ai:end marker lines from a generated app, keeping their content

fill-flow-slots.description: Lists the empty flow-* step slots of an emitted app; without an AI executor it reports and touches nothing

app.description: Generates a runnable backend project from the registered resource models
